title: energy.predictions event (1-step-ahead hourly forecast)
description: 1-step-ahead forecast for the next hourly window. event_time is the predicted window start (UTC). trigger_event_id is the hourly event whose arrival triggered this forecast.

run_id.description: One id per experiment run, shared across all topics.

meter_id.description: Kafka message key. uci-001 is the real series; uci-002.. are load replicas.

model.description: Model identifier used for this forecast (e.g. 'lstm', 'sarima').

confidence_lower.description: Optional lower bound of confidence interval.

confidence_upper.description: Optional upper bound of confidence interval.

rolling_mae.description: Recent rolling MAE of this model at time of prediction.

rolling_rmse.description: Recent rolling RMSE of this model at time of prediction.

trigger_event_id.description: event_id of the energy.hourly event that triggered this prediction.

trigger_replay_time_ms.description: replay_time_ms of the trigger event for end-to-end latency tracking.

emit_time_ms.description: Wall-clock epoch-ms when the forecaster emitted this record.
